reason: The sums look right, but it is a concept for a guesthouse I don't run, from a studio I found on Instagram. I would want to see a real property it has done before I pay $800 to someone who doesn't know my guests or my Booking.com listing.
objection: I already have a booking engine and a Booking.com listing that works. What exactly changes for my rooms, and who fixes it when the WhatsApp reminder or the deposit link breaks in the middle of the season?
would_change_my_mind: A real guesthouse like mine that has used this setup for a few months, with the direct bookings and commission saved shown in its own numbers.
